work_completed: Added WorldEngineServer.Target.cs with non-editor server target settings.
Added DefaultServer.ini with Workplace_Level as the server default map and NLTDemoGameMode as the server game mode.
Added FNLTRandomStream InitialSeed metadata and deterministic Reset behavior.
Updated deterministic seed serialization to retain reset metadata while accepting the legacy Seed+Calls format.
Added FNLTDeterministicStateHash with a versioned canonical state representation and BLAKE3 digest.
Added three UE AutomationTests for random-stream reset, seed serialization, and canonical state hashing.
Added a versioned JSON replay record with state, RNG, action, event, and hash integrity verification.
Added replay round-trip, malformed JSON, tamper, and observed-final-state AutomationTests.
Added shared configurable visual LOD policy with distance thresholds, hysteresis, viewer fallback, and Mesh/HISM/fallback representation selection.
Integrated visual-only LOD filtering into Mass HISM visualization and actor-resident mesh visibility without changing simulation state or update rates.
Added four LOD policy AutomationTests for thresholds, hysteresis, representation/fallback, and viewer fallback.
Added dedicated-server guards preventing local-player spawn retries and door spawning on headless servers.
Created the required Cline agent registration record.
